stories.title: Flintshire’s £1m super-tip clean-up cost still unrecovered
stories.summary: Two years after a major fire in Queensferry triggered an investigation into an illegal waste site no-one has been held accountable for the £1m clean-up operation. stories.title: Citizens Advice Cymru reports record debt levels among people seeking help in Wales
stories.summary: Citizens Advice helped nearly 194,000 people in Wales last year, with energy debt now the most common debt problem its advisers deal with. stories.title: Delsol asks council to rule overnight lorry movements at Sandycroft depot are lawful
stories.summary: A Sandycroft delivery firm has asked Flintshire County Council to rule that night-time lorry movements at its depot are lawful, despite a planning condition banning operations between midnight and 6.30am.
